note: Anchor set for the Halide-world index. Rule: Halide papers with at least one of Saman Amarasinghe, Jonathan Ragan-Kelley, Andrew Adams, Fredo Durand or Shoaib Kamil as an author, applied as 'title or venue carries the word Halide'. Every DOI alias must be listed: several anchors are indexed under both a proceedings DOI and a journal-issue DOI, and citation services split their citing lists across them. Harvesting only one alias of the PLDI 2013 paper returns 555 citing works; harvesting both returns 966.
